summary: Measured the CEILING of onboarding-KB value by denying repo access to BOTH harness answer arms (empty cwd + `--tools ""` + no-access instruction in onboard-harness.js claude()/answerPrompt). KB notes are now the only project-specific source. Fresh trustworthy reading (sonnet, 7 project + 4 control): cold_rate_control=100% (validity intact), cold_rate_project=29% (was 86% with repo access), kb_rate_project=86%, kb_earned_project=57% (4/7). Floor→ceiling bracket: 14% → 57%. Verified no fabrication — cold refuses/misses project specifics, still aces controls. Committed harness change + reading on orch/attempt/onboarding-kb (eddfaba). Recommend GO on learning loop /11. Did NOT build /11.
